posts.name: La Verde Cafe
posts.note: Wellness cafe inside the Ignite + Aliign fitness studio on Kensington Road by Ulsoor Lake (date is the source's publication date).
body: The menu centres on functional beverages, superfood-led drinks and dishes, with a hydration bar and pastries from local bakers.

posts.name: JSan
posts.note: Goa's izakaya-style ramen bar opens a 34-seater in an Indiranagar bylane (date is the source's publication date).
body: Broths are simmered for 48 hours with noodles made in-house, and the menu offers six noodle types, from tonkotsu to veggie shoyu ramen, plus small plates like kobujime salmon.

posts.name: Chor Bizarre
posts.note: The Delhi Kashmiri-and-regional Indian restaurant makes its southern debut, with a whisky library bar.
body: Launched on November 15, 2026 with an evening of poetry and conversation with Javed Akhtar and Shabana Azmi; reservations open November 17. The menu mixes Kashmiri specialities like tabak maaz and goshtaba with South Indian dishes such as meen moilee and chicken chettinad.
It includes Past Times – The Whiskey Library, a bar with 50+ whiskies.

posts.name: Kuchina
posts.note: Handmade pasta and wine bar from Kompany Hospitality (Soka, Kalpaney), opened in Indiranagar on Nov 15.
body: Fresh dough is made from scratch daily, with pasta rolled, cut and shaped in-house, plus a separate dried pasta programme led by Chef Partner Sombir Chaudhary.

posts.name: Beanlore
posts.note: The neighbourhood café brand's fourth outlet, in an old bungalow with a garden and its first two-floor layout.
body: The ground floor opens into the garden and is kept laptop-free, while the first floor is a work-friendly zone. Coffee is roasted in-house from Chikkamagaluru beans, and the outlet debuts a soft serve counter with flavours that change through the week.
The brand says a fifth café is expected within three months.

posts.name: Boston Pub
posts.note: A five-floor, ~12,000 sq ft pub and dining venue for about 400 guests, with rooftop seating and a basement dance floor.
body: Each floor is meant for a different mood: indoor dining and a pub for relaxed evenings, a rooftop for sitting out, and a dance floor downstairs. Interiors by Vinay Agnelo F. D'Almeida mix vintage details with contemporary touches, and DJ nights, live music and themed events are planned.

Food is built for sharing across Asian and Korean-inspired dishes, Indian appetisers, pizzas and Continental plates, with vegetarian options throughout. Signature cocktails sit alongside non-alcoholic drinks like Ruby Fizz and Baklava Brew. Founded by Subbaiah, Preetham, Hem and Ashwin.

posts.name: Coffee Island Beyond
posts.note: The European specialty coffee brand's first Bengaluru store, in its new 'Beyond' format.
body: Coffee Island, which describes itself as Europe's No. 1 specialty coffee brand, runs roughly 9 to 10 cafés across India. The Beyond format pitches an experience that goes past coffee, with a focus on sustainability, mindfulness and community.
The store is at No. 580, Aswan Plaza, Ground Floor, Satyakrupa, 20th Main Road, Koramangala 8th Block.

posts.name: BuCo.
posts.note: Chef Shriya Shetty's Mangalore-based artisanal bakehouse makes its Bengaluru debut in a bungalow in Indiranagar, with bakes, burgers, desserts and a filter coffee-led drinks menu.
body: The cafe sits under two large rain trees at 6th Cross Road, HAL 2nd Stage, and serves a breakfast menu alongside its signature bakes.

posts.name: Cooke Town
posts.note: Renaissance Bengaluru Race Course Hotel's new all-day dining restaurant puts Anglo-Indian cuisine at the heart of its menu.
body: Named after the old Bengaluru neighbourhood, the menu was developed by Executive Chef Ho Chi Ming with Anglo-Indian culinary historian Bridget White-Kumar, alongside select regional and international dishes.

posts.name: Barcode Restopub
posts.note: A new restopub on New BEL Road, inaugurated on Sunday, November 1 with Kannada actor Gilli Nata cutting the ribbon.
body: The pub was started by Sudhakar Gowda, a close friend of Gilli Nata, and the launch also drew actors Arun Gowda and Payal.

posts.name: Coffee Buddy
posts.note: The Filipino coffee chain opens its Bengaluru outlet in Indiranagar, serving premium coffee made with 100% Arabica and Robusta beans.
body: Coffee Buddy started in 2019 as a small online coffee bean store in Manila and came to India through a master franchise with Franchise India, opening first in Mumbai in August 2026.

posts.name: GATO House
posts.area: HSR Layout (22nd Cross, 20th Main Rd, Sector 2)
posts.note: A new cafe for brews, bakes and Pan-Asian food, with drinks like Rose Matcha, Kyoto Blanc and cold brews served on tap.
body: Open 11 am to 11:30 pm, about ₹1,500 for two.

posts.name: Koko Samba
posts.note: A 42,000 sq ft fire-lit restaurant and bar with space for 750 covers, pitched somewhere between a loud brewery and a quiet cocktail bar.
body: Food is built for sharing at the centre of the table, and some evenings bring drums, dance and performance while others stay quieter.
Interiors by Abhigyan Neogi draw on tribal and tropical settings, with rock formations, a water body and water-wheel, bamboo, cane and thatch.

posts.name: Chifa
posts.note: A Chinese-Peruvian restaurant built around migration cuisine, blending Chinese cooking techniques with Peruvian flavours.
body: It has three dining spaces: The Valley, an intimate room; The Crossing, built for social gatherings; and The Canopy, an outdoor area overlooking the city.

posts.note: The Chennai-born Greek yogurt brand's first Bengaluru kiosk, serving slow-churned, preservative-free, all-vegetarian yogurt as dessert.
body: The yogurt is served chilled rather than frozen for a thick, velvety texture, with 6 to 8 grams of protein per scoop. Open daily from noon to 10pm.
